title: nephrolepis rivularis
intro: Nephrolepis rivularis, commonly known as the fishbone fern, is a species of fern in the family Lomariopsidaceae. This plant is known for its unique fishbone-like fronds, which are said to have various health benefits. The health benefits of Nephrolepis rivularis include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
